description: This file provides utility functions for handling tree-sitter parsing, including language support, query loading, and symbol extraction from source code files.

methods.name: getParserForFile
methods.description: Initializes and returns a web-tree-sitter parser for the specified file, loading the appropriate language dynamically.

methods.name: findExistingPath
methods.description: Finds the first existing path from a list of candidate paths.

methods.name: getLanguageForFile
methods.description: Determines the language of a file based on its extension and loads the corresponding web-tree-sitter language object.

methods.name: getFullLanguageName
methods.description: Returns the full language name for a given file path or URI based on its extension.

methods.name: getQueryForFile
methods.description: Loads a tree-sitter query for a specific file based on a query path, resolving the correct file location.

methods.name: loadLanguageForFileExt
methods.description: Loads the web-tree-sitter language object for a given file extension, locating the appropriate WASM file.

methods.name: getSymbolsForFile
methods.description: Parses a file's contents to extract symbols such as classes and functions using tree-sitter.
